questions: What should happen if a team appears in the goals or penalties dict but is not in TEAMS? Should it be ignored, raise an error, or something else?
Should the function always return a DataFrame with exactly the five teams in TEAMS, in that order, even if some have no data in the input dicts?
Is the clipping range GOALS_RANGE applied to the net score (goals - penalties) or separately to goals and penalties before subtraction?
What data types are expected for goals and penalties values? Must they be integers, or can they be floats?
Should missing keys in goals or penalties for a team in TEAMS default to 0, as in the reference solution, or should they be treated differently (e.g., NaN)?
Is the bar chart required to be displayed (plt.show()) or just generated? The prompt says 'visualizes results', but reference solution includes show().
Should the y-axis limits of the plot be exactly GOALS_RANGE[0]-1 to GOALS_RANGE[1]+1 as in reference, or dynamically determined from data?
What should happen if goals or penalties values are negative? Are negative goals allowed (as in GOALS_RANGE includes negative)?
